solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"condition"** refers to the state or situation of something.
 
• In the context of the passage, "condition" suggests a state of unreason or irrationality that the speaker is experiencing.
 
• The other options: "stance," "glance," and "status" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "For all that I knew this perfectly well, I still felt as if it were not safe to let the coach-office be out of my sight longer than five minutes at a time; and in this condition__ of unreason I had performed the first half-hour of ..."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stance (दृष्टिकोण)**: refers to a way of thinking about something or an attitude.
 
• **Glance (झलक)**: means a brief or hurried look.
 
• **Status (स्थिति)**: refers to the social or professional position of someone or something.
